about: Where each platform draws its own UI over a video, as fractions of the frame (x0, y0, x1, y1; y down). The 9:16 numbers are the platforms' own for ads (a call-to-action button makes the bottom band a little deeper than an ordinary post's), measured from their templates by Solid Labs (https://www.solidlabs.com/social-safe-zones), checked 2026-08-07. YouTube's 16:9 player publishes none: its zones are the player's own title and controls, with the 90% title-safe frame. The apps move: update this file, not the code.
